summary: Iteration 15 testing PASSED. All 5 backend pytest tests green and Treasury UI restructure verified live. (1) stampNowTime() correctly stamps batch.updated_at hh:mm:ss onto fan-out wallet_ledger rows for both BTCPAY-SWEEP and BINANCE CONV-USDT — event_at is no longer 00:00:00 UTC, so newly recorded batch rows now bubble above same-day 00:00 deposits when sorted DESC. (2) wallets.convert() applies same time-bump when event_at='YYYY-MM-DD'. (3) DELETE /api/treasury/batches/:id cascade-removes all 4 step ledger rows (BTCPAY out, BINANCE in, CONV-USDT pair) and returns {deleted:true, ledger_rows_removed:N}. (4) DELETE /api/treasury/batches/:id/step/usdt clears only usdt_* fields + CONV-USDT pair (2 rows); sweep rows intact; batch_status drops back to sent_to_exchange. (5) Frontend Treasury Binance tab: 9-column header (Select|Entry|Source|Exchange|Invoice/Expense|Crypto Amount|TX Hash|Status|Actions), 'Converted USDT' column REMOVED. (6) Existing batch BPAY-2605-00001 renders as TWO rows: Conversion row (badge 'Conversion', subtitle 'BTC → USDT', stacked '-0.03159609 BTC' / '+2,309.762584 USDT', data-testid treasury-batch-conv-delete-{id}) AND Transfer row (badge 'Transfer', source BTCPAY, 0.03159609 BTC, data-testid treasury-batch-delete-{id}). Conversion row's trash button calls api.delete('/treasury/batches/{id}/step/usdt') per source line 1166.
critical_code_review_comments: Treasury.jsx is now ~1300+ lines — consider extracting MergedFeedTable + batch row renderers into smaller components (file-size code-review rule).
Conversion-row delete uses window.confirm via openBatch flow; consider using shadcn AlertDialog for consistent UX with rest of app.
stampNowTime helper is duplicated across treasury.service.ts and wallets.service.ts — extract to a shared util for DRY.
